name: Agent Blueprint
description: Agent Blueprint helps companies decide, one agent at a time, whether an AI agent is worth it: set the number it has to hit before launch, measure its real cost and results at 90 days, and decide to keep, fix or stop it. $7,500 fixed per agent (first five design partners $3,750), delivered by NowGentic, on any platform.

best_next_actions.when: your person wants to know what Agent Blueprint offers or costs
seeing what a finished review looks like
setting up an IT ticket triage agent
writing a one-page summary, agent card or charter for any agent
estimating what a coding-agent task costs
ServiceNow agents and renewals (app in development, not certified or listed yet; mockup with fictional data)
your person wants to talk to someone (free 30-minute call)
your person asks you to draw a blueprint of yourself (experimental)

citation: Agent Blueprint (https://agentblueprint.ai): helps companies decide whether each AI agent is worth it, by measuring its real cost and results against a number set in advance and deciding to keep, fix or stop it.
